# homarr_board_settings (Data Source)

Reads the appearance and behaviour settings of a Homarr board.

~> **Requires Homarr 2.3.0 or newer**, which added `GET /api/boards/{id}/settings`.

~> **Needs *modify* access to the board**, not the *view* access that listing boards requires — unusual for a data source, and a read-only API key will not work. Homarr answers `404` rather than `403` for a board it will not show you, so an insufficient key looks like a missing board.

These fields are deliberately absent from `homarr_board` and its data sources, which are built on `GET /api/boards` and need only *view*; folding them in there would raise that permission floor for every existing configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reading board settings needs *modify* access to the board, not the *view*
# access that listing boards requires, so a read-only API key will not work.
data "homarr_board_settings" "infra" {
  id = homarr_board.infra.id
}

# Copy one board's look onto another.
resource "homarr_board_settings" "staging" {
  board_id      = homarr_board.staging.id
  primary_color = data.homarr_board_settings.infra.primary_color
  item_radius   = data.homarr_board_settings.infra.item_radius
  opacity       = data.homarr_board_settings.infra.opacity
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the board to read.

### Read-Only

- `background_image_attachment` (String) How the background image scrolls, `fixed` or `scroll`.
- `background_image_repeat` (String) How the background image repeats.
- `background_image_size` (String) How the background image is scaled, `cover` or `contain`.
- `background_image_url` (String) URL of the board's background image.
- `custom_css` (String) Custom CSS applied to the board. Homarr reports `""` rather than null when no CSS is set, because that column is not nullable.
- `disable_status` (Boolean) Whether online-status pings are disabled for items on this board.
- `favicon_image_url` (String) URL of the board's favicon.
- `icon_color` (String) Icon tint as a six-digit hex value, or null when unset.
- `item_radius` (String) Corner radius of board items.
- `logo_image_url` (String) URL of the logo shown in the board's header.
- `meta_title` (String) Value of the page's `<meta>` title, used by link previews.
- `name` (String) Name of the board, as reported alongside its settings.
- `opacity` (Number) Opacity of board items, from `0` to `100`.
- `page_title` (String) Title shown in the browser tab for this board.
- `primary_color` (String) Primary accent colour as a six-digit hex value.
- `secondary_color` (String) Secondary accent colour as a six-digit hex value.
